description: A `<var server>` in a file with NO `<program>` at all, but WITH a `<db src=>` state block, does NOT fire E-AUTH-005: the `<db>` block IS the server context §52.11 asks for. This is the canonical MULTI-FILE page shape (§40.8 / S85 Q2 — exactly one `<program>`, in the entry file; page and component files carry none), so a file-local `<program db=>` search can never succeed for it however legitimate its server side.
rationale: Complements auth-005-pos (no server context at all -> fires) and auth-005-neg (`<program db=>` -> silent) with the third shape: server context supplied by `<db src=>` rather than by `<program db=>`. Without this case the checker may regress to a `<program>`-only search, which made `<var server>` structurally unavailable to every multi-file page.
